✨ nullframe | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide developers and designers with a visually engaging and performant real-time dashboard of browser performance metrics, styled according to the Nothing design language.
✨ Key Features: • Live telemetry dashboard • Nothing design language aesthetic (dot-matrix numerals, glyph-grid icon reel)
📖 Summary: Project Nullframe is a live telemetry dashboard designed with the Nothing design language. It displays real-time browser performance metrics like frame rate, memory usage, battery status, and network information using a distinctive dot-matrix aesthetic and industrial instrument panel style.
